description: This Java interface defines generic database operations for OpenMRS objects within the OpenMRS API, including methods for retrieving, deleting, and saving objects based on identifiers or UUIDs.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectDAO
classes.description: A generic interface for CRUD operations on OpenMRS data objects, parameterized to work with subclasses of BaseOpenmrsObject.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an object by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an object by its UUID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified persistent object from the database.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new persistent object or updates an existing one in the database.
